groups.problem: The Meet-location check dereferences an undefined first destination calendar when the destination list is missing or empty.
groups.rationale: Every suggestion identifies the same unguarded mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration access and proposes restoring optional chaining.

groups.problem: Google updateEvent and deleteEvent use a falsy externalCalendarId as the lookup key in their fallback branches, preventing destination-calendar fallback.
groups.rationale: The same faulty conditional lookup appears in both methods and requires the same correction at each occurrence. Suggestions covering both occurrences describe this single repeated mistake.

groups.problem: Calendar implementations retain one-parameter createEvent signatures after the interface adds a required credentialId parameter.
groups.rationale: These suggestions report the same alleged signature-contract mismatch across implementations. S8 mentions credential-based selection only within its proposed fix; S3 broadly describes consequences of the alleged mismatch.

problems: Office365 createEvent lacks the credentialId parameter required by the updated interface.
Office365 creates events using the first destination calendar instead of the destination belonging to the current credential.
uncoveredProblems: Office365 selects destinationCalendar[0] instead of matching the current credential.
